units.source_text: 沙丘的山脊变得舒缓，与大海相反的一侧，有块凸出的部分。

en.t: The ridge of the dune grew gentler, and on the side opposite the sea there was a protruding section.

units.source_text: 那儿看上去似乎会有什么收获，他不知不觉地走了过去。

en.t: It looked as though he might find something there, and before he knew it he had walked over.

units.source_text: 沿着舒缓的斜坡，可以看到星星点点散布着芦苇防沙墙的遗迹，

en.t: Along the gentle slope, he could see the remains of reed sandbreak walls scattered here and there,
and one level farther down there was a stretch of flat ground.

units.source_text: 沙丘上整齐划一的风纹，像用机器刻下来似的，

en.t: The neat, uniform wind ripples on the dune looked as if they had been carved by a machine,

units.source_text: 他跨过风纹，忽然视野切断，

en.t: and as he stepped across them, his field of vision was suddenly cut off,

units.source_text: 眼前是个深深的洞穴，往下望去，

en.t: with a deep pit before his eyes; when he looked down,

units.source_text: 才知道原来自己已经站在崖边了。

en.t: he realized that he was already standing at the edge of a cliff.
